summary: Full backend+frontend verification for Dynamik-Werkbank iteration (phases/versions/restore, workbench pause/resume/reset, regime-lab active filter, dynamic backtest local worker). 14/14 existing unit tests pass; wrote 14 additional API tests (all green) against public preview; executed end-to-end UI flow (login→Tools→Optimizer→Dynamische Strategie→Bestehende optimieren→select Seed Dynamisch) and confirmed dpe-panel, 3 rows, select options, confirm box, keep-release checkbox, successful phase change (row 0 skip -> 'nicht handeln'), new version appended (9→10), history toggle, mobile 390px no overflow. JobControls (dwb-pause/resume/stop/cancel/reset) wiring verified by code review (RegimeJobProgress.JobControls used by DynamicWorkbenchFields with testId='dwb'); live pause/resume not executed because starting a real workbench job requires internet-fed candles outside preview scope – API-level pause/resume/reset endpoints are covered by tests.

issues: dpe-reset-tp checkbox is only rendered for strategy/optimized actions – for 'skip' it is not shown; this is likely intentional but not documented in the task spec. Minor UX note only.

critical_code_review_comments: DynamicPhaseEditor API uses body key 'regime_id' (numeric) – frontend uses this correctly; keep consistent in any future endpoints.
JobControls component shared between Regime-Lab and DynamicWorkbenchFields via testId prop – good DRY pattern.

Startup produces several 'Failed to fetch' console errors from fetchSession/fetchNotif before token is injected; harmless at test time but could be guarded with an auth-ready check to reduce log noise.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed dyn_seed1 and ra_seed1; the versions counter advanced from 5→10 across the run (restores, skips, strategy changes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed strategy dyn_seed1 now has >=10 versions; v1 was restored multiple times. If testing restore to v1 again, status should return to 'validated'. Preview backend occasionally times out on first call (~15s cold); use 60s timeout in requests. Public URL: https://trader-refactor-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Workbench live pause/resume requires an actual running job (needs candles) – only API endpoints are easily unit-testable in preview.
